key_insight: Genetic algorithms design interpretable spatial descriptors that balance local-response prediction error against the number of image-derived features.
engineering_relevance: Compact, explicit image measurements can help engineers identify which surrounding structures matter for predicting local spectra and hysteresis loops.
method: Benchmark regression models and use SHAP maps to examine spatial attribution.
Evaluate how image patch size and compression affect accuracy and descriptor dimensionality.
Evolve Cartesian and polar partitions with mean, minimum, and maximum pooling.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes regression benchmarking and accuracy–dimensionality evaluation for local spectra and hysteresis loops, but reports no numerical results.
watch_item: Extension to molecules and solids requires new genetic algorithm rules and is not demonstrated in the abstract.
paper_title: Evolutionary Design of Interpretable Spatial Descriptors for Structure-Property Relationship Discovery
